# Generative Engine Solutions (GES)

> Self-serve platform for Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)

GES helps businesses improve their visibility and citation rate in AI-powered search engines and large language model responses.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://generativeenginesolutions.com/): Overview of the GES platform and its 5 modules
- [What is AEO?](https://generativeenginesolutions.com/what-is-aeo): Comprehensive guide to Answer Engine Optimization
- [Pricing](https://generativeenginesolutions.com/pricing): Three tiers, Free ($0, 5 credits), Growth ($299/mo, 50 credits), Scale ($799/mo, 200 credits)

## Modules

1. AEO Intelligence Report: Diagnoses AI visibility across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overview, Gemini, and Copilot
2. Org Schema Builder: Generates JSON-LD structured markup for LLM parsing
3. Company Intelligence Gatherer: Builds proof-point libraries that AI engines cite
4. ICP Content Strategy: Maps content pages to buyer questions that AI systems answer
5. Page Converter: Transforms existing pages into LLM-optimized content assets
